exposure: Congenital Mesoblastic Nephroma (CMN) characteristics (pathological subtypes, gestational age at diagnosis, associated conditions like polyhydramnios, hypertension, tumor stage)
cohort: The study included 11 cases with congenital mesoblastic nephroma (CMN) prenatally diagnosed at a single center between 2015 and 2019.
finding: The prognosis for prenatal congenital mesoblastic nephroma (CMN) cases is excellent following early surgical intervention.
gest_age: The median gestational age at sonographic diagnosis was 35 weeks, and some cases resulted in preterm birth.
